name: sub-meter
description: Subscription usage at the bottom right of the prompt: the 5-hour and weekly windows, a hover card with reset times and pace, and /sub-meter.

display.title: What the meter shows
display.description: rotate: the 5-hour and weekly windows in turn. both: the two side by side. session: the 5-hour window only. week: the weekly window only.

rotateSeconds.title: Seconds per window
rotateSeconds.description: How long each window shows before the meter switches to the other, with display set to rotate.

hideCycleHint.title: Hide the mode cycle hint
hideCycleHint.description: Drop "(shift+tab to cycle)" from the hint line, to leave room for the meter.

hideInterruptHint.title: Hide the interrupt hint
hideInterruptHint.description: Drop "esc to interrupt" from the hint line while Claude works, to leave room for the meter.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the labels and the /sub-meter output: en (English) or es (Spanish).
